name: autonomy-status
question: What is the resolved autonomy level for this session, what is its source, and what is the resolved per-domain consultation vector?
cost_provenance: measured 2026-06-12 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment) -- pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01; under-declaration causes timeout kills

schema.level: one of: autopilot, supervised, collaborative, controlled, manual
schema.submode: autopilot submode when the resolved level is autopilot: one of continuous, phase, session, task, director; null otherwise (AUTODEF-01)
schema.source: one of: session-override, ltads-session, task-arc-autonomy, config, config-cap, machine-default, default
schema.source_detail: human-readable description of source location and resolution path
schema.briefing: string for [autonomy] briefing line; empty when level==collaborative AND no domain override is active. ALWAYS non-empty when source is machine-default or config-cap (AUTODEF-04: an ambient standing grant must be unmissable), carrying submode and, for a cap, capped_from
schema.domains: object; ALL SIX keys always present (spec, plan, delegate, decide, quality, commit). The resolved per-domain consultation setting = level default (frozen AUTODOM-03 matrix), tightened by any honored override. THIS is the field consumers read (AUTODOM-02)
schema.domain_overrides: array of domain names whose explicit override was HONORED (i.e. it tightened the level default)
schema.domain_clamped: array of {domain, requested, clamped_to} — overrides that would LOOSEN the level default. Tighten-only (AUTODOM-04): the level default stands and the attempt is reported, never silently honored
schema.domain_invalid: array of {domain, requested} — unrecognized option values. Level default stands; reported so a typo'd tightening request is never silently dropped

consultation.rationale: Cascade resolution otherwise duplicated across session-start.{sh,ps1}, /0-uldf-autonomy-set status display, and ad-hoc consumers. One oracle call per session-start; zero per follow-up consumer. Since v1.1.0 this oracle is also the SOLE mechanical consumer of autonomy domain settings (AUTODOM-02) — before it, nothing on disk read a domain override and setting one did literally nothing.

fallback: Treat resolved level as 'collaborative' and the domain vector as the collaborative row of the AUTODOM-03 matrix. The cascade's documented default is collaborative; agents falling through to default carry no risk beyond the existing default behavior. A missing domain vector means 'no domain override is in effect', which is the common case.

provenance.authored_by: AUTONOMY-02 plan arc; domain vector added by the AUTODOM arc (2026-07-13); machine-default cascade source + director submode by the AUTODEF arc (2026-07-20)
provenance.decision_ref: DEC-39 (cascade is canonical consent gate), DEC-40 (task-arc-autonomy.json schema), DEC-172 (wire domain settings rather than retire them; tighten-only clamp), DEC-189 (machine-default cascade source, autopilot:director, downward cap)
